en: Color-printed vintage postcard showing a dramatic, foaming river rapid or waterfall rushing between rocky banks and forested shores. Dense coniferous trees line both sides, and in the background a narrow bridge spans the river above the rapids. The print has a grainy, slightly faded look with worn corners, consistent with early 20th‑century postcards. No visible caption or text appears on the image side.
